<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:240px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#b5dcf2}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { mergeVertices } from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xb5dcf2);

// ---------- lights ----------
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xbfae90, 2.0));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0); key.position.set(3, 6, 6); scene.add(key);
const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.4); back.position.set(-4, 4, -6); scene.add(back);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6); fill.position.set(-5, 2, 3); scene.add(fill);

// ---------- helpers ----------
const mat = (c, r = 0.6, extra = {}) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(Object.assign({ color: c, roughness: r, metalness: 0 }, extra));
const sphereGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 24);
function ell(name, m, rx, ry, rz, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const me = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, m);
  me.name = name;
  me.scale.set(rx, ry, rz);
  me.position.set(x, y, z);
  return me;
}

const M = {
  yellow: mat(0xffd83a, 0.55),
  belly: mat(0xfff0ad, 0.6),
  mouth: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0, emissive: 0x220406, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
  tongue: mat(0xff8b98, 0.5),
  white: mat(0xffffff, 0.3),
  pupil: mat(0x17110a, 0.25),
  nostril: mat(0xb97a10, 0.7)
};

// ---------- character ----------
const nailong = new THREE.Group();
nailong.name = 'character-nailong';
scene.add(nailong);

// body
const body = new THREE.Group(); body.name = 'body';
body.position.set(0, 1.05, 0);
body.add(ell('torso', M.yellow, 0.95, 1.0, 0.9));
body.add(ell('belly', M.belly, 0.68, 0.72, 0.5, 0, -0.1, 0.45));
nailong.add(body);

// tail (short tapered cone with a soft tip)
const tail = new THREE.Group(); tail.name = 'tail';
tail.position.set(0, 0.6, -0.45);
tail.rotation.x = 0.3;
{
  const pts = [new THREE.Vector2(0, 0)];
  const N = 18, L = 1.15, R0 = 0.34;
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const s = Math.sin(0.5 * Math.PI * i / N);
    const r = R0 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - Math.pow(s, 1.7)), 0.75);
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(r, s * L));
  }
  const tm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts, 28), M.yellow);
  tm.name = 'tail-cone';
  tm.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  tm.scale.set(1, 1, 0.9);
  tail.add(tm);
}
nailong.add(tail);

// legs
function makeLeg(sign, name) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = name;
  g.position.set(sign * 0.44, 0.22, 0.12);
  g.add(ell(name + '-foot', M.yellow, 0.34, 0.22, 0.48));
  return g;
}
nailong.add(makeLeg(1, 'leg-left'));
nailong.add(makeLeg(-1, 'leg-right'));

// arms
function makeArm(sign, name, rz, rx) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = name;
  g.position.set(sign * 0.76, 1.55, 0.1);
  g.rotation.set(rx, 0, sign * rz);
  const arm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.17, 0.4, 6, 16), M.yellow);
  arm.name = name + '-upper';
  arm.position.set(0, -0.3, 0);
  g.add(arm);
  const hand = new THREE.Group(); hand.name = name.replace('arm', 'hand');
  hand.position.set(0, -0.6, 0);
  hand.add(ell('palm', M.yellow, 0.21, 0.21, 0.21));
  g.add(hand);
  return g;
}
nailong.add(makeArm(1, 'arm-left', 1.15, -0.25));
nailong.add(makeArm(-1, 'arm-right', 1.0, -0.25));

// ---------- head ----------
const RX = 1.3, RY = 1.0, RZ = 1.1;
const W = 1.0, H = 0.73, YT = -0.03, CURL = 0.2, D = 0.3;
const surfZ = (x, y) => RZ * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (x / RX) ** 2 - (y / RY) ** 2));
const yTop = u => YT + CURL * u * u;
const depthUV = (u, v) => D * (1 - u * u) * 4 * v * (1 - v);
function mouthDepth(x, y) {
  const u = x / W;
  if (Math.abs(u) >= 1) return 0;
  const e = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u);
  const v = (yTop(u) - y) / (H * e);
  if (v <= 0 || v >= 1) return 0;
  return depthUV(u, v);
}

const head = new THREE.Group(); head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, 2.55, 0);
head.rotation.set(-0.12, 0, 0.05);
nailong.add(head);

let hg = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 96, 64);
hg.deleteAttribute('normal');
hg.deleteAttribute('uv');
hg = mergeVertices(hg, 1e-4);
{
  const hp = hg.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < hp.count; i++) {
    const x = hp.getX(i) * RX, y = hp.getY(i) * RY;
    let z = hp.getZ(i) * RZ;
    if (z > 0) z -= 1.25 * mouthDepth(x, y);
    hp.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
  }
  hg.computeVertexNormals();
}
const skull = new THREE.Mesh(hg, M.yellow);
skull.name = 'skull';
head.add(skull);

// mouth: wide open laughing cavity
const mouth = new THREE.Group(); mouth.name = 'mouth';
head.add(mouth);
{
  const NU = 56, NV = 24, pos = [], col = [], idx = [];
  const cA = new THREE.Color(0x96202c), cB = new THREE.Color(0x40070f), cT = new THREE.Color();
  for (let i = 0; i <= NU; i++) {
    const u = (i === 0) ? -1 : (i === NU ? 1 : -Math.cos(Math.PI * i / NU));
    const x = W * u;
    const e = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u));
    const yt = yTop(u), yb = yt - H * e;
    for (let j = 0; j <= NV; j++) {
      const v = j / NV, y = yt + (yb - yt) * v;
      pos.push(x, y, surfZ(x, y) - depthUV(u, v) + 0.012);
      const k = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep((1 - u * u) * 4 * v * (1 - v), 0.25, 0.95);
      cT.lerpColors(cA, cB, k);
      col.push(cT.r, cT.g, cT.b);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < NU; i++) for (let j = 0; j < NV; j++) {
    const a = i * (NV + 1) + j, b = a + 1, c = a + NV + 1, d = c + 1;
    idx.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
  }
  const mg = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  mg.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  mg.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
  mg.setIndex(idx);
  mg.computeVertexNormals();
  const cavity = new THREE.Mesh(mg, M.mouth);
  cavity.name = 'mouth-cavity';
  mouth.add(cavity);
}
const tongue = new THREE.Group(); tongue.name = 'tongue';
tongue.position.set(0, -0.56, 0.7);
tongue.add(ell('tongue-body', M.tongue, 0.46, 0.19, 0.17));
mouth.add(tongue);

// nostrils
for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
  head.add(ell('nostril', M.nostril, 0.035, 0.026, 0.015, s * 0.09, 0.14, surfZ(s * 0.09, 0.14)));
}

// eyes: frog-like bulges sitting high on the head, poking above its outline
const eyes = new THREE.Group(); eyes.name = 'eyes';
head.add(eyes);
const ER = [0.32, 0.37, 0.2];
function capGeo(angle, seg) {
  const g = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, seg, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, angle);
  g.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
  return g;
}
const pupilGeo = capGeo(0.58, 32);
const glintGeo = capGeo(0.16, 16);
function makeEye(sign, side) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = 'eye-' + side;
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3(sign * 0.16, 0.22, 1).normalize();
  g.position.set(sign * 0.37, 0.66, 0.86);
  g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), dir);
  g.add(ell('eye-socket', M.yellow, 0.365, 0.415, 0.30, 0, 0.015, -0.16));
  g.add(ell('eyeball', M.white, ER[0], ER[1], ER[2]));
  const p = new THREE.Group(); p.name = 'pupil-' + side;
  p.scale.set(ER[0] * 1.03, ER[1] * 1.03, ER[2] * 1.03);
  const iris = new THREE.Mesh(pupilGeo, M.pupil); iris.name = 'iris';
  iris.rotation.set(0.14, -sign * 0.14, 0);
  p.add(iris);
  const glint = new THREE.Mesh(glintGeo, M.white); glint.name = 'highlight';
  glint.scale.setScalar(1.03);
  glint.rotation.set(-0.08, -sign * 0.14 + 0.22, 0);
  p.add(glint);
  g.add(p);
  return g;
}
eyes.add(makeEye(1, 'left'));
eyes.add(makeEye(-1, 'right'));

// ---------- ground shadow ----------
const shadow = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.CircleGeometry(1.35, 40),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000, transparent: true, opacity: 0.16, depthWrite: false })
);
shadow.name = 'ground-shadow';
shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
shadow.position.y = 0.005;
scene.add(shadow);

// ---------- camera ----------
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(1.6, 2.7, 8.2);
camera.lookAt(0, 1.85, 0);
camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [nailong],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
